notes: Translated from the W3C ODRL CG formal-semantics examples (w3c/odrl@1db8e6b, folder A Evaluation of Constraints/A1). The CG's evaluatedAction/Target/Party become the request; requestParameters describing sotw:CurrentXSDDateTime become request.at and effective_at (odrl:dateTime is the action time in due2-core). The CG reports a controlState: Inactive is Deny under its default 'close' behaviour, where due2 says NotApplicable and leaves the default to the enforcement point. Timezone-less instants are read as UTC (due2 instants are UTC, workflows §2). The CG compares the action time (xsd:dateTime) with "2018-01-01"^^xsd:date. due2 rejects that at normalisation (OperatorTypeMismatch: the right operand does not conform to the operand's range, due2-profiles.md §3); the translation substitutes the instant 2018-01-01T00:00:00Z, which gives the CG's verdicts. Comparison across XSD date/time types — and timezone-less values, which XSD orders only partially — is unspecified in ODRL 2.2 and worth settling in the formal semantics. A2 has no evaluation requests and is not translated.
